plan.summary: Fixes a race in `count` by removing the `dir.exists()` pre-check. A missing directory is now handled by `fs::read_dir` returning `NotFound`, which gives `Ok((0, 0))`. The PR also removes the `drop(guard)` call and its comment from `main`.
plan.riskRationale: The `count` change is small and removes a check-then-act race. The `main` change removes an explicit telemetry guard drop. This may change when telemetry flushes, because `std::process::exit` does not run destructors.
plan.storyArc: The PR first removes the race in directory counting. It then shows a separate change to process shutdown, which needs a check that telemetry still flushes before exit.

topics.title: Handle a missing directory in the read, not by a prior check
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `count` now treat a missing directory without the race between `exists()` and `read_dir`? Verify that the `NotFound` arm returns `Ok((0, 0))` and that other errors still propagate.

topics.title: Telemetry guard no longer dropped before process exit
topics.narrativeBrief: What happens to the telemetry flush now that `drop(guard)` and its comment are gone? Verify whether `std::process::exit` skips the guard's destructor, which would stop the flush the removed comment required.
